questions.question_text: What is the primary goal of sustainability?

options.text: To use up all resources as quickly as possible for economic growth
To meet current needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs
To focus only on environmental protection and ignore social needs
To increase pollution to support industrial developmentCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT one of the three pillars of sustainability?
Why is sustainability especially important for teens?

options.text: Teens are the only ones who can solve environmental problems
Teens will inherit the future impacted by today’s environmental issues
Teens are not affected by sustainability challenges
Teens have no role in creating change for the environmentCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a global environmental challenge mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: Development of new video gamesCorrect Answer: B
